Lina: FYI postmortem follow-up: I sketched SLO/SLA adjustments and a short remediation plan after yesterday's throughput spike.
Omar: thanks Lina. can you summarize the SLO deltas?
Lina: tl;dr: keep global availability SLO at 99.95%, add a per-model throughput SLO for heavy-gen (soft cap) at 250rps per cluster, and temporarily increase p99 latency allowance from 700ms -> 900ms for non-prod model cohorts while batching rollout happens.
Priya: adding a per-model throughput SLO sounds useful for routing decisions. do we change error budget burn policy?
Lina: yes — policy change: error budget is conserved but we will not auto-scale beyond reserved capacity for 30m after a sustained burn to avoid cascading failures. alerting will page on sustained burn > 10% over 1h.
Ben: can you paste the alert rule you'll add?
Lina: here it is:
``n
ALERT SLO_ErrorBudget_Burn
IF (sum(rate(errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m]))) > 0.10
FOR 60m
LABELS {severity="page"}
``n
Priya: minor nit: use metric name request_errors_total for clarity and include job="runtime" filter.
Lina: good call, updating.
Omar: who is owning the dashboard tile that surfaces recurring incident patterns (by model/tag/client tier)? we had trouble correlating last time.
Lina: Proposal: infra builds the core dashboard over next 3 days, then hand to runtime for enrichment. Owner timeline: Omar (build core, due 2112347600), Priya (add model tagging and runbook, due 2112351200). Ben will coordinate support/comms.
Ben: I'll sync with Support to prepare the customer threshold doc and escalation steps.
Priya: I'll add a small regression detector job that compares cohorts week-over-week and alerts anomalies to the SLO slack channel (non-pager).
Omar: do we want temporary external notice to customers?
Ben: agreed with ops: only if we see any customer impact > 1% of requests. otherwise internal only.
svc-bot: Incident-#4782 status updated: cause -> worker pool saturation; mitigation -> throttled background jobs and increased KV cache TTL.
Lina: Action items written to follow-up list: 1) add per-model throughput SLO + dashboard tile (Omar, due 2112347600) 2) change error-budget policy and add burn alert (Lina, due 2112346800) 3) regression detector job (Priya, due 2112351200) 4) support escalation doc (Ben, due 2112349000).
Omar: I'll start the dashboard panel and post queries in the #slo-dash repo. ping me in thread if you need sample traces.
Priya: I'll prototype the cohort detector using our nightly aggregates.
Ben: calendar invite for a check-in Friday 10:00 sent to owners.
Lina: thanks all. aim to re-tighten p99 back to 700ms once batching fixes land + two successful regression checks. check-in Friday. :rocket:
